title: Memo
description: Cross-invocation memory store for agents. Any subagent (researcher / writer / extractor / renderer) or the deal_orchestrator coordinator can write memos summarising learnings, observations, or patterns. Future agent invocations retrieve memos via the `read_memos` tool using tag filters (talent_id, brand_id, industry_id, deal_id, topics, scope). Persistence is intentionally cross-scope: a memo written during a Phase 4.7 contract negotiation for one brand may surface later when prepping a proposal for a competitor in the same industry. v0.1 = explicit write + deterministic tag-filter retrieval (no vector embedding); v0.2 may add pgvector for semantic retrieval. Stored as a row in Postgres + (optionally) markdown content blobs in S3 if length exceeds DB threshold. See `docs/architecture.md` § 5 Memo store.

agency_id.description: Multi-tenant scope: FK to agency_profile.agency_id. Optional in v0.1 (single-tenant deploys may omit); required in v2 SaaS. When present, all cross-record queries MUST filter by agency_id to prevent cross-tenant data leakage. See docs/data_lineage.md GAP-01/02 for rationale.

scope.description: How broadly this memo applies. deal_specific: only relevant to one deal (e.g. 'agent regenerated slide 4 with feedback X'). brand_relationship: relevant whenever this brand surfaces (e.g. 'Brand X requires GDPR addendum on all contracts'). industry_pattern: pattern observed across multiple brands in an industry. talent_pattern: pattern about a specific talent's deals/preferences. cross_cutting: applies across deals/brands/industries (e.g. 'whitelisting > 60d is usually a redline').

memo_type.description: What kind of memo this is. Drives downstream retrieval — e.g. the proposal pack's writer subagent queries `objection_handler` + `negotiation_pattern` memos for this brand to inform commercial proposal rationale.

content_markdown.description: The memo body in markdown. Typically 1-5 paragraphs; targets agent consumption (concise, factual, action-oriented). Larger memos may be stored in S3 with `content_markdown_s3_key` field overriding inline content; v0.1 = always inline.

structured.description: Optional structured payload alongside the narrative content. Free-form per memo_type — e.g. for `negotiation_pattern` might contain `{redlines_received: [...], counter_offers: [...], final_terms: {...}}`. Schema validation is permissive (additionalProperties: true) to support memo-type evolution.

tags.description: Tag filters drive retrieval. The orchestrator and subagents query `read_memos(...)` with combinations of these tags. Multiple values per tag = OR; multiple tag keys = AND.

talent_ids.description: Talent slugs this memo references. Empty = not talent-specific.

brand_ids.description: Brand slugs this memo references. Empty = not brand-specific.

industry_ids.description: Industry slugs this memo applies to. Empty = not industry-specific. Often populated even when memo is brand-specific (broader retrieval surface for cross-brand learning).

deal_ids.description: Deal IDs this memo references. Supports both pipeline (`deal_pipeline_*`) and archived (`deal_*`) deal_id formats.

topics.description: Free-form topic tags for fuzzy semantic matching. Convention: lowercase, kebab-case (e.g. 'exclusivity', 'payment-terms', 'usage-rights', 'gdpr', 'audience-mismatch', 'red-line-breach', 'kpi-overperformance'). Required (at least 1) to encourage explicit categorisation.

phase_context.description: Which phase of the deal lifecycle was active when this memo was written. cross_phase = memo intentionally spans phases (e.g. 'this brand's contract negotiation always slows delivery by 2 weeks').

created_by_agent.description: Which agent (or human) authored the memo. `human_agent` = the user manually wrote it via the UI. `renderer` is included for completeness but rarely writes memos (deterministic agent, few learnings).

created_in_pack_id.description: If the memo was written during a pack generation, captures the pack_id (`prep_*` / `pp_*` / `cp_*` / `inv_*_seq*_v*` / `perf_*`). Null for orchestrator-level memos or human-written memos.

supersedes_memo_id.description: Optional FK to a prior memo this one replaces. The superseded memo's `is_active` flips to false on the orchestrator's next write. Used when a learning evolves (e.g. v1 said 'Brand X never accepts 90d whitelisting'; v2 corrects after they did).

expires_at.description: Optional TTL. After this timestamp, the memo is no longer surfaced by `read_memos` (filtered server-side). Useful for time-bound observations (e.g. 'Brand X paused all influencer campaigns Q3 2026' — expires when Q3 ends).

is_active.description: Soft-delete flag. Inactive memos are excluded from `read_memos` by default but preserved for audit. Flipped to false when superseded or when an agent/human marks the memo as no-longer-valid.

retrieval_count.description: How many times this memo has been returned by `read_memos`. Auto-incremented. Useful signal: high-retrieval memos are validated learnings; never-retrieved memos may be noise.

last_retrieved_at.description: Most recent time `read_memos` returned this memo. Stale memos (never retrieved in N months) become v0.2 cleanup candidates.
